notes: The Membership and Rotation start-up waits are 5 s instead of 3 s: one run under load (podman machine load average about 3.8) gave 'b70 proposes: no-majority prepare 1', and two reruns matched; listen sockets already set SO_REUSEADDR.
Race counts vary between runs (one-round control 0/20, 2/20, 1/20 agreeing); retries agreed 20/20 in each.
The token file's mode is not checked (wire 35 has no stat).
Every block was run as documented in fresh directories; no Node, NBB, JVM, hosted compiler, C compiler or C loader runs.
